purpose: Check whether a single input-independent output correction restores the two frozen direct-margin points. Not a new defense, original AGA replacement or classifier fit using real labels.
rule: For each own fused model, p_cf=mean softmax(logits(noise)); predict argmax(logits(test)-log(p_cf)). This is the official diagonal probability division computed stably in log space. One fixed rule, no scale/temperature/mapping/source/seed selection.
adaptation: Original paper uses content-free language strings; here exactly64 fixed unoptimized uniform-noise images are image-domain probes, not an official CLIP reproduction or a claim that noise represents the natural task.
input_definition: CPU torch.rand(64,3,32,32), uniform[0,1],bilinear224 align_cornersFalse,originalCLIPnormalization,batches8,no labels/no pixel optimization.
attacker_information: Own already-created fused model, fixed public classifier/class IDs and synthetic noise. Fitting does not access original target expert, real training/test data, old clean teacher generated cache, protected-source data or labels. Research assembly uses pinned published/original-AGA weights and own partner exactly as the original fixed merging evaluation. The unprotected matched release is corrected by the same rule on itself.
freeze_order: Save calibration vectors andSHA before opening any raw test score or label file. Then read frozen full MNIST/SVHN scores for evaluation only. No defense parameter changes, no choice of decoder from these results.
checks: Independent NumPy stable softmax/mean/log-prior and predictions; official full labels/indices; classwise and paired changes; preserve original raw scores and same matched unprotected controls.
mechanism: If logits(x)=task_signal(x)+constant_bias and content-free inputs identify that bias, subtracting logprior cancels it up to a class-independent scalar. Probe-dependent residuals and feature-normalization can violate that model; actual results required. Failure of one fixed correction does not prove erased class information.
cost: 576 generated-image forwards,0 new natural-image forwards,0 new AGA,0 defense/teacher updates. Retire the one-off source after exact source archive; no production entrypoint or new framework.
